measurement_note: tmux destroys the pty slave when the pane process exits; a bash wrapper records pony's exit code then execs `sleep` to hold the pts open (no termios writes), so post-exit stty/capture-pane are measurable.  SIGTERM is sent only to the real pony child PID.

isolation.telemetry: PONY_OTEL_*/PONYSENTRY_*/OTEL_* overridden to empty or dead loopback port; OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER=always_off; OTEL_SDK_DISABLED=true; gateway/provider/proxy all pointed at a closed 127.0.0.1 port

assertions.name: 全局: 负向控制——wrapper/harness 自身不会复原 termios（判据判别力）
assertions.actual: child=tty.setraw 无还原, 退出后 stty -F /dev/pts/0 rc=0 negative=['-isig', '-icanon', '-echo', '-opost'] positive=[] pane='RAW-CONTROL-READY'
assertions.expected: raw flags 持续残留（证明 smoke 的 POST 复原来自 pony 自身而非 harness）

negative_control.purpose: negative control: wrapper/harness must NOT restore termios by itself
negative_control.conclusion: 同一 wrapper 下把 pony 换成 tty.setraw 且不还原的子进程，退出后 -isig/-icanon/-echo/-opost 四项全部持续残留；因此 smoke 两条路径 POST 全正向复原只能由 pony 的 restore_terminal_modes/tcsetattr 贡献。
